result.topic_en: Fragments on representing primes 8n+3 as x^2+2y^2 (with uniqueness proof and examples), and product (composition) identities for the quadratic forms abpp+cdqq, aa+ab+bb and aa+2βab+γbb.
result.transcription:
Fragmenta ex Adversariis deprompta. 159
stratur non omnes numeros $a^{4n}-b^{4n}$ divisibiles esse. Dantur ergo casus, quibus forma $a^{4n}+b^{4n}$ est divisibilis. Habebitur ergo summa duorum biquadratorum divisibilis $A^4+B^4$. Quare cum sit $a^4+b^4=(aa-bb)^2+2aabb$, propositum est demonstratum. — Ita cum 97 in forma $8n+1$ contineatur, reperitur $97=5^2+2.6^2$.
Theorema. Omnis numerus primus formae $8n+3$ simul in forma $xx+2yy$ continetur.
Demonstratio. Iterum sufficiet ostendisse, dari formam $A^2+2B^2$ per $8n+3$ divisibilem. Cum igitur haec forma $a^{8n+2}-b^{8n+2}$ semper sit divisibilis, quicunque numeri pro $a$ et $b$ accipiantur, erit vel $a.a^{4n}-b.b^{4n}$, vel $a.a^{4n}+b.b^{4n}$ divisibilis. Jam sumatur $a=cc$ et $b=2dd$ ut $a.a^{4n}$ fiat quadratum $A^2$ et $b.b^{4n}$ duplum quadratum, puta $2B^2$, sicque vel forma $A^2-2B^2$, vel $A^2+2B^2$ divisionem admittet per $8n+1$. At vero demonstratum est, formam $A^2-2B^2$ alios divisores non admittere, nisi vel formae $8n+1$, vel formae $8n-1$, unde sequitur alteram formam $A^2+2B^2$ divisibilem esse. Ita cum sit $107=8.13+3$, reperitur esse $107=3^2+2.7^2$, hocque semper unico modo, quod ita demonstratur:
Sit $P=aa+2bb$ simulque $P=cc+2dd$, numerus $P$ necessario est compositus. Cum enim sit
$aa+2bb=cc+2dd$, erit $aa-cc=2(dd-bb)$,
unde sequitur $\frac{a+c}{b+d}=\frac{2(d-b)}{a-c}=\frac{p}{q}$. Erit ergo $a+c=\alpha p$ et $d+b=\alpha q$, $d-b=\beta p$ et $a-c=2\beta q$. Hinc $2a=\alpha p+2\beta q$ et $2b=\alpha q-\beta p$; quare cum $4P=4aa+2.4bb$ erit $4P=(\alpha\alpha+2\beta\beta)(pp+2qq)$, sicque $4P$ certe duos habet factores, quorum neuter unquam esse potest neque 1 neque 4; sequitur $P$ ad minimum duos habere factores:
$3=1^2+2.1^2$ $59=3^2+2.5^2$
$11=3^2+2.1^2$ $67=7^2+2.3^2$
$19=1^2+2.3^2$ $83=9^2+2.1^2$
$43=5^2+2.3^2$ $107=3^2+2.7^2$.
Notandum hic, praeter casum primum, in omnibus reliquis alterum quadratum semper per 9 esse divisibile.
A. m. T. III. p. 180. 181.
6.
Theorema. Propositis numeris quibuscunque $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, si numerus formae $abpp+cdqq$ multiplicetur per numerum formae $acrr+bdss$, tum productum semper continebitur in hac forma $bcxx+adyy$.
Demonstratio facile patet. Sumto enim $x=apr+dqs$ et $y=bps-cqr$, postrema forma $bcxx+adyy$ reperitur productum binarum praecedentium.
A. m. T. III. p. 182.
(Golovin.)
Theorema. Productum ex duabus hujusmodi formulis $aa+ab+bb$ et $cc+cd+dd$ semper ad similem formam $xx+xy+yy$ reduci potest. Est enim duplici modo
vel $x=ac+b(c+d)$ et $y=ad-bc$
vel etiam $x=ad+b(c+d)$ et $y=ac-bd$.
Ita si fuerit $a=3$ et $b=2$, tum vero $c=1$ et $d=5$, erit $aa+ab+bb=19$ et $cc+cd+dd=31$; prior igitur resolutio dat $x=15$ et $y=13$, hincque $xx+xy+yy=589$.
A. m. T. II. p. 204.
(Lexell.)
Theorema. Si formula $\alpha aa+2\beta ab+\gamma bb$ per aliam sui similem $\alpha pp+2\beta pq+\gamma qq$ multiplicetur, productum prodit hujus formae
$xx+2\beta xy+\alpha\gamma yy$ eritque $x=\alpha ap-\gamma bq$ et $y=aq+bp+\frac{2\beta}{\alpha}bq$.
Corollarium. Ita si fuerit $\alpha=1$, $2\beta=1$ et $\gamma=1$, erit $(aa+ab+bb)(pp+pq+qq)=xx+xy+yy$ existente $x=ap-bq$ et $y=aq+bp+bq$.
Nota Editorum. Casum specialem, quo $\beta=0$, vide Comment. arithm. T. II, p. 201.
A. m. T. I. p. 26.

methods.what: Every prime 8n+3 is x^2+2y^2, via divisibility of a^{8n+2}-b^{8n+2} with a=c^2, b=2d^2 and divisors of A^2-2B^2
methods.quote: Omnis numerus primus formae $8n+3$ simul in forma $xx+2yy$ continetur.

methods.what: Uniqueness: two representations as x^2+2y^2 imply factorization 4P=(α^2+2β^2)(p^2+2q^2), so P composite
Product of two forms a^2+ab+b^2 is again x^2+xy+y^2, two ways
Composition of αa^2+2βab+γb^2 with itself into x^2+2βxy+αγy^2
methods.quote: $xx+2\beta xy+\alpha\gamma yy$ eritque $x=\alpha ap-\gamma bq$ et $y=aq+bp+\frac{2\beta}{\alpha}bq$

items.quote: Omnis numerus primus formae $8n+3$ simul in forma $xx+2yy$ continetur.
items.english: Every prime number of the form 8n+3 is also contained in the form xx+2yy.
and this always in a unique way.

items.quote: Notandum hic, praeter casum primum, in omnibus reliquis alterum quadratum semper per 9 esse divisibile.
items.english: Note here that, except for the first case, in all the others one of the squares is always divisible by 9.

items.quote: Productum ex duabus hujusmodi formulis $aa+ab+bb$ et $cc+cd+dd$ semper ad similem formam $xx+xy+yy$ reduci potest.
items.english: The product of two formulas aa+ab+bb and cc+cd+dd can always be reduced to the similar form xx+xy+yy.

items.quote: Propositis numeris quibuscunque $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$, si numerus formae $abpp+cdqq$ multiplicetur per numerum formae $acrr+bdss$, tum productum semper continebitur in hac forma $bcxx+adyy$.
items.english: Given any numbers a, b, c, d, if a number of form abpp+cdqq is multiplied by a number of form acrr+bdss, the product will always be contained in the form bcxx+adyy.

items.quote: Si formula $\alpha aa+2\beta ab+\gamma bb$ per aliam sui similem $\alpha pp+2\beta pq+\gamma qq$ multiplicetur, productum prodit hujus formae
items.english: If the formula αaa+2βab+γbb is multiplied by another similar one αpp+2βpq+γqq, the product comes out of this form (xx+2βxy+αγyy).
